name: Result
brief: Enumeration specifying the result from the APIs.
description: All ThorVG APIs could potentially return one of the values in the list. Please note that some APIs may additionally specify the reasons that trigger their return values.

members.name: Success
members.brief: The value returned in case of a correct request execution.

members.name: InvalidArguments
members.brief: The value returned in the event of a problem with the arguments given to the API - e.g. empty paths or null pointers.

members.name: InsufficientCondition
members.brief: The value returned in case the request cannot be processed - e.g. asking for properties of an object, which does not exist.

members.name: FailedAllocation
members.brief: The value returned in case of unsuccessful memory allocation.

members.name: MemoryCorruption
members.brief: The value returned in the event of bad memory handling - e.g. failing in pointer releasing or casting

members.name: NonSupport
members.brief: The value returned in case of choosing unsupported engine features(options).

members.name: SystemError
members.brief: The value returned when an underlying system operation fails.

members.name: Unknown
members.brief: The value returned in all other cases.
